Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner wrongly disambiguated “Permission to Fly” as Jordan Rudess’s work (even citing Wired for Madness) instead of Jordan Pruitt’s 2008 album, despite search results already indicating Hollywood Records. This led the process to pursue the wrong artist/release and conclude the incorrect label (Inside Out Music) rather than the correct Hollywood Records.
